name: agent-workspace
description: Agent Workspace — Local AI agent platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,dashboard -c cyan,green "npm --workspace=apps/gateway run dev" "npm --workspace=apps/dashboard run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/gateway && npm run build --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,dashboard -c cyan,green "npm --workspace=apps/gateway run start" "npm --workspace=apps/dashboard run start"
